subject: Payments Feature Delay — Executive Summary
body:
Hi Raj,

I wanted to give you a heads-up before the board call. The Payments feature will be delayed from December 15 to approximately January 20, 2025.

Root cause: PCI-DSS Level 1 compliance requirements identified by Kenji Nakamura (see email_02) require infrastructure changes and a mandatory third-party penetration test. The pen test alone takes 3–4 weeks to complete and schedule.

Additional factors:
- The Stripe integration has a secondary blocker: Arjun Mehta found that our API rate limiting implementation (tracked in NEX-231) conflicts with Stripe's webhook retry mechanism. See ticket NEX-231 and the related PR #47 which is currently in review.
- We underestimated the compliance scope during initial planning.

I'm confident the January 20 date is achievable if the pen test vendor is contracted this week. I'll have a formal revised timeline ready by EOD.

Best,
Priya
